title: 941. Delete Columns to Make Sorted II

examples.explanation: Drop the first column to get a, b, c.

hints: Scan columns left to right, remembering which adjacent row pairs are already strictly ordered by kept columns.
Drop a column when an undecided pair steps down in it; otherwise keep it and mark newly ordered pairs as decided.
A kept column never harms decided pairs, so this greedy pass is optimal.
